data.one_liner: A vertical YouTube shorts video player widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a vertical TikTok/Shorts style video feed playing YouTube shorts using a list of URLs or channel names. Includes support for inline ads, custom overlays, loading states, and media controls.
use_when: You want to build a YouTube Shorts or vertical video feed in your app
You need to display shorts from specific YouTube channels or a list of video URLs
avoid_when: You need standard horizontal video playback or full-featured YouTube embedding
You cannot use media_kit native dependencies
strengths: Supports multiple content sources including URL lists, single channels, and multi-channels
Includes features for ads integration, custom overlays, and error widgets
weaknesses: Relies on media_kit which requires platform-specific native setup and permissions
Dependent on web scraping and YouTube internal APIs which can be fragile
data.setup_notes: Requires media_kit native configurations, calling MediaKit.ensureInitialized(), and handling runtime storage/video permissions.
